title: Metformin attenuates placental oxidative stress through Nrf2/Keap1 signaling in preeclampsia rats.
authors: Xu, Miao; Zhang, Xinhuan; Ma, Huijing; Wang, Fang; Li, Mengnan; Zhang, Ruidan; Yang, Lijun; Zhang, Nan; Ren, Xiaorui; Hao, Huiniu; Hao, Zhuanghui; Yang, Hailan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究二甲双胍通过Nrf2/Keap1信号通路缓解子痫前期大鼠胎盘氧化应激，虽含分子对接与动力学模拟，但核心是湿实验与临床病理，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，仅方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Preeclampsia (PE) represents a severe gestational disorder defined by the development of hypertension accompanied by systemic organ dysfunction during pregnancy, affecting 3 %-5 % of pregnancies globally and contributing markedly to maternal-perinatal mortality. Placental oxidative stress (OS) is a key pathophysiological driver. A well-known antidiabetic drug metformin (MET) possesses anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, suggesting its therapeutic potential for PE; however, its molecular mechanisms remain unclear. METHODS: A PE-like rat model was established using N(omega)-nitro-l-arginine methyl ester (l-NAME), a nitric oxide synthase inhibitor. Pregnant Sprague-Dawley rats (n = 30) were divided into the control, l-NAME, and l-NAME + MET groups. We evaluated clinical parameters (blood pressure, proteinuria, placental, and renal histopathology), angiogenic factors (soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase-1 (sFlt-1) and placental growth factor (PlGF)), and OS markers (malondialdehyde (MDA), superoxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px), and catalase (CAT)). Nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2)/Kelch Like ECH Associated Protein 1 (Keap1) signaling analysis employed western blotting, immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence and reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR). Molecular docking and dynamics simulations explored MET's interaction with the Nrf2-Keap1 complex. RESULTS: Significant reductions in systolic blood pressure, proteinuria, and placental-renal histopathological damage, along with improved fetal weight, were observed with MET treatment. It normalized the sFlt-1/PlGF ratio and boosted antioxidant enzyme activities. MET promoted nuclear Nrf2 translocation, upregulated NAD(P)H:quinone oxidoreductase 1 (NQO1), and suppressed Keap1. Molecular modeling suggests that MET-induced destabilization of the Nrf2-Keap1 complex facilitates Nrf2 dissociation. CONCLUSION: MET mitigates l-NAME induced oxidative stress by activating the Nrf2 signaling pathway, highlighting its potential as a novel therapeutic target for PE management.
abstract_zh: 背景：子痫前期（PE）是一种严重的妊娠期疾病，其特征为妊娠期间出现高血压并伴随全身器官功能障碍，影响全球3%-5%的妊娠，并显著增加母胎死亡率。胎盘氧化应激（OS）是关键病理生理驱动因素。一种知名的抗糖尿病药物二甲双胍（MET）具有抗炎和抗氧化特性，提示其在PE中的治疗潜力；然而，其分子机制尚不清楚。方法：使用一氧化氮合酶抑制剂N(omega)-硝基-L-精氨酸甲酯（l-NAME）建立PE样大鼠模型。孕Sprague-Dawley大鼠（n = 30）分为对照组、l-NAME组和l-NAME + MET组。我们评估了临床参数（血压、蛋白尿、胎盘和肾脏组织病理学）、血管生成因子（可溶性fms样酪氨酸激酶-1（sFlt-1）和胎盘生长因子（PlGF））以及OS标志物（丙二醛（MDA）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GSH-Px）和过氧化氢酶（CAT））。核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）/Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）信号通路分析采用蛋白质印迹法、免疫组织化学、免疫荧光和逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）。分子对接和动力学模拟探讨了MET与Nrf2-Keap1复合物的相互作用。结果：MET治疗观察到收缩压、蛋白尿和胎盘-肾脏组织病理损伤显著降低，同时胎重改善。它使sFlt-1/PlGF比值正常化并增强抗氧化酶活性。MET促进核Nrf2转位，上调NAD(P)H:醌氧化还原酶1（NQO1），并抑制Keap1。分子建模提示，MET诱导的Nrf2-Keap1复合物去稳定化促进Nrf2解离。结论：MET通过激活Nrf2信号通路减轻l-NAME诱导的氧化应激，突显其作为PE管理新治疗靶点的潜力。
